caption: Agent Evidence Attribute Dictionary
description: Attributes contributed by the agent_evidence extension.
name: dictionary

agent_evidence_predicate_type.caption: Predicate Type
agent_evidence_predicate_type.description: The predicateType URI of the evidence statement, for example https://probityai.github.io/agent-evidence-vectors/predicate/v1/agent-audit-record. The URI names the record format the statement carries; a consumer picks the verifier by it.

agent_evidence_statement_digest.caption: Statement Digest
agent_evidence_statement_digest.description: SHA-256 of the evidence statement's bytes, written as sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits. A consumer fetches the statement from the locations listed and rejects it when its digest differs.

agent_evidence_locations.caption: Statement Locations
agent_evidence_locations.description: URLs from which the evidence statement can be fetched.

agent_evidence_conformance_corpus.caption: Conformance Corpus
agent_evidence_conformance_corpus.description: Name and version of the public conformance corpus the producer's verifier was run against, for example agent-evidence-vectors==0.29.3.

evidence_reference_data.caption: Data
evidence_reference_data.description: Payload of the evidence reference module. Module payload objects are self-typed in the dictionary so that the module's data attribute resolves to the object rather than to a string.
